name: FORGE default opportunity model
description: Ranks by risk-adjusted return and reuse of FORGE infrastructure, per the owner's stated preference. Score = 100 * sum(weight * score/5). Adjusted score multiplies each criterion by its evidence multiplier, so thinly evidenced ideas cannot outrank well evidenced ones on optimism alone.

criteria.label: Demand evidence
criteria.question: How strong and durable is measurable search or marketplace demand for the problem?

anchors.0: No evidence anyone searches or buys
anchors.3: Consistent autocomplete, competitor listings with reviews, stable Trends
anchors.5: Measured keyword volume plus sales evidence (review counts, bestseller ranks) and stable or rising 5-year Trends

criteria.label: Willingness to pay
criteria.question: Is there evidence this audience pays for a digital product like ours, at what price?

anchors.1: Free substitutes dominate; paid items rare
anchors.3: Multiple paid sellers with reviews at our price band
anchors.5: Many paid sellers at or above our price with strong review counts; buyers frame it as a business expense or gift

criteria.label: Competitive gap
criteria.question: Is there a clear quality or positioning gap we can own?

anchors.0: Saturated by strong incumbents with free tools
anchors.3: Crowded but generic; a premium, well-designed offer stands out
anchors.5: Underserved: few credible offers, poor UX, unmet sub-need

criteria.label: Unit economics
criteria.question: Margin after fees, delivery and support at the expected price?

anchors.3: Digital product with >80% margin at under $15 AOV
anchors.5: >85% margin and AOV >= $25 or natural bundle/upsell

criteria.label: Speed to first revenue
criteria.question: How quickly can a sellable product reach checkout?

criteria.label: FORGE reuse
criteria.question: How much existing FORGE infrastructure (sites, ledger, checkout, Pinterest drip, calculators, email) does it reuse?

anchors.5: Reuses nearly everything and adds reusable capability back

criteria.label: Free acquisition fit
criteria.question: Is there a free, compliant channel where this audience already searches or browses (SEO, Pinterest, YouTube, communities)?

anchors.5: Two or more strong organic channels with evergreen intent

criteria.label: Seasonal timing
criteria.question: Does the next demand window leave enough lead time to build and rank?

anchors.0: Peak just passed; next is 10+ months out with no evergreen demand
anchors.3: Evergreen or next peak 3-6 months away
anchors.5: Evergreen with an upcoming peak 3-5 months out

criteria.label: Low support and maintenance
criteria.question: How little ongoing support, updates and customer service does it need?

criteria.label: Low legal, platform and IP risk
criteria.question: How free is it from regulatory, licensing, platform-policy and IP exposure?

anchors.0: Licensed advice, safety claims or heavy policy risk

criteria.label: Strategic and owner fit
criteria.question: Does it fit the owner's goals (shovel-seller tools, portfolio, low maintenance, family time)?

anchors.5: Strong fit and builds a reusable FORGE capability

gates.rule: Product must not require professional licensing or give regulated advice (legal, medical, financial, engineering sign-off).
Launch cost must fit the owner-approved budget envelope without new paid tools.
At least one free acquisition channel scored >= 3.
Required criteria must not be UNKNOWN and total non-UNKNOWN weight >= min_evidence_coverage.
No dependence on others' trademarks, characters or unlicensed assets.

changelog.change: Initial model. Weights reflect owner preference for risk-adjusted ROI and FORGE reuse (handoff §5.1). Recalibrate after the first 90 days of first-party sales data.
